Title: EXP-001: Explore the employee and ESS account lifecycle for unexpected behaviour
Comment:
A 45-minute exploratory session was completed according to the defined mission and goals.


The following areas were explored:


1. Employee creation in PIM.

2. ESS account creation and status changes.

3. Data consistency between PIM, User Management, and My Info.

4. Admin and ESS permissions.

5. Login and logout behaviour.

6. Unexpected navigation and validation behaviour.


Observations:


1. No validation message was displayed after selecting an unsupported profile picture format.

2. An invalid Date of Birth value could be saved.

3. Personal Details updated in My Info were not synchronized with PIM.

4. An ESS user could access User Management through a direct URL.

5. A disabled ESS account could still be used to log in.


All identified issues were reproduced and documented as Jira defects.
